intent.oneSentence: A faint branching leader connects downward, a brief bright discharge lights its main channel, a weaker pulse reuses that channel, and fixed residual light fades.
intent.firstRead: A sudden forked lightning strike, not a traveling energy projectile.
intent.mustNotReadAs: A blue comet, evenly spaced flat zigzag ornament, identical white noodle branches, or a slowly wiggling neon wire.
intent.useContext: Native pixel VFX over dark, light and patterned ground backgrounds.

readability.primaryShape: One dominant crooked channel with asymmetric unequal rooted branches and fine secondary dead-end forks.
readability.focalPoint: The brief white main return channel, not detached particle confetti.
readability.depthAndOverlap: Thin side branches remain subordinate to the main connected path.
readability.contrast: Small high-current core and localized atmospheric glow; no full-screen white frame.
readability.secondaryDetailBudget: No invented burning ground, smoke or falling debris. Side forks shorten and fade earlier than the main channel.

mechanics.source: A descending ionized leader between a fixed elevated source and receiving point.
mechanics.driver: Connection enables an upward return-current front; a second pulse reuses the established main path.
mechanics.direction: Leader reveal downward, return current upward, afterglow stationary.
mechanics.weightAndMaterial: Brief luminous plasma, not chunks of material under gravity.
mechanics.causalChain: Faint connected leaders reach their parent junctions before growing branches. Connection precedes the first return pulse. A weaker less-branched repeat uses the same trunk; residual emission fades without moving the topology.
mechanics.endingRule: All current ceases and residual channel light cools to an empty frame.
mechanics.exaggerationAndLimits: Leader/stroke times are deliberately extended for readable pixel animation. This is not real-time atmospheric physics, an electromagnetic simulation, or Unreal/Niagara rendering.

phases.name: preparation
phases.action: Faint branching leader approaches the receiving point.
phases.visibleCue: Dim unequal rooted branches grow downward.

phases.name: action
phases.action: A bright return front lights the connected main channel.
phases.visibleCue: Short high-contrast trunk and weaker branches.

phases.name: response
phases.action: A weaker repeat reuses the trunk.
phases.cause: Remaining discharge follows the established channel.
phases.visibleCue: Same crooked primary path with fewer visible side forks.

phases.name: ending
phases.cause: Current stops and the channel cools.
phases.visibleCue: Thin dim traces fade to empty without flying off.

references.observed: Official text describes branching negative cloud-to-ground leaders, rapid upward return strokes and repeats reusing the main channel with fewer branches.
references.application: Separate persistent branched geometry from leader extent, connected current pulses and fading stationary residual.
references.limits: Official source text verified; external photo/high-speed-video pixels unavailable from the connected tools. Actual atmospheric timing is much faster. No direct external visual inspection or full-speed local playback is claimed.

references.observed: Persistent unequal fork topology and connected path illumination already exist in separate renderers.
references.application: Use the same design principles with existing 2D Painter path/glow helpers without importing or changing the 3D engine or old effects.
references.limits: No full-speed viewing or user approval is recorded.
